response.sql: WITH fee_groups AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_rate FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS net_rate FROM fees) SELECT AVG(fee_groups.avg_rebate) AS avg_total_rebate, AVG(fee_groups.avg_net_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(fee_groups.avg_net_rate - benchmark.net_rate) AS avg_excess_net_fee_rate FROM fee_groups CROSS JOIN benchmark WHERE fee_groups.avg_net_rate > benchmark.net_rate;
